title: Mauryan sources: more texts and detail

boxes.title: Arthashastra & Indica: added
items: Arthashastra topics: **slavery** rules, ==**Saptanga** state==, revenue, courts
Indica classes: philosophers, farmers, soldiers, herdsmen, artisans, overseers, councillors
Palace remains at **Kumrahar**; Andhra army also cavalry, elephants
**Strabo**, following him: ==Indians did not know writing==

boxes.title: Other sources & debates
items: Also: **Kalpasutra, Jatakas, Dighanikaya**; ⚠ Milindapanho = Menander, not Mauryan
PMC + NBPW also in **Bangladesh, Odisha, Karnataka**
